description: The standard keyword ranking function: idf-weighted, saturated term frequency with document length normalization. Default in Lucene, Elasticsearch and OpenSearch.
Inverse document frequency: terms found in few documents weigh more. BM25 uses `ln(1 + (N - n + 0.5) / (n + 0.5))`.
BM25 parameter for term frequency saturation, usually 1.2 to 2.0. Larger values let repeated terms keep adding score longer.
BM25 parameter for length normalization from 0 (ignore length) to 1 (full normalization); default 0.75.
Running keyword and vector retrieval and fusing their rankings, so exact identifiers and paraphrases are both found.
Fuses rankings with the sum of `1 / (k + rank)`, k = 60. Uses ranks only, so retrievers with incomparable scores combine safely, and agreement is rewarded.
How many results each retriever contributes before fusion or reranking. Fusion can only reorder what was retrieved, so candidates exceed the final topK.
Models such as SPLADE that produce weighted term vectors for an inverted index, between BM25 and dense embeddings.
